verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a hiring/ATS platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Lever offers a self-hosted or on-premises deployment. Every item describes Lever-hosted SaaS features and APIs. The integrator sandbox is a separate environment that Lever itself hosts, so it is not self-hosting and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
